title: Positivity
subtitle: 「正面態度／積極心態／樂觀精神」是一個相當寬的抽象名詞。要先分清它是在說：對未來抱好期待、處理問題很建設性、心態正面、充滿希望、有信心，還是團隊氣氛積極。
description: 「正面態度／積極心態／樂觀精神」是一個相當寬的抽象名詞。要先分清它是在說：對未來抱好期待、處理問題很建設性、心態正面、充滿希望、有信心，還是團隊氣氛積極。

options.explanation: Optimism ✓ — means expecting favourable outcomes or believing that things will improve; it is strongly future-oriented. In this sentence, expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning. That makes Optimism the most precise choice rather than merely a broadly positive word.

Positive attitude — is a broad everyday phrase for a generally favourable and encouraging way of behaving or thinking. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning.

Hopefulness — means feeling hopeful about a good outcome; it is more emotion-focused than optimism. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning.

Confidence — means belief in ability, reliability or likely success; it is narrower than general positivity. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning.

Happiness — is an emotional state of being happy and does not necessarily imply optimism or constructive behaviour. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning.

Enthusiasm — is strong interest and energy, not necessarily optimism or constructive thinking. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: expectation of a favourable outcome is the central meaning.

exercises.upgrade: The successful test increased confidence in the new system.

options.explanation: Confidence ✓ — means belief in ability, reliability or likely success; it is narrower than general positivity. In this sentence, evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work. That makes Confidence the most precise choice rather than merely a broadly positive word.

Optimism — means expecting favourable outcomes or believing that things will improve; it is strongly future-oriented. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work.

Hopefulness — means feeling hopeful about a good outcome; it is more emotion-focused than optimism. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work.

Positive outlook — means a generally hopeful way of viewing life, a situation or the future. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work.

Enthusiasm — is strong interest and energy, not necessarily optimism or constructive thinking. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work.

Happiness — is an emotional state of being happy and does not necessarily imply optimism or constructive behaviour. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: evidence has strengthened belief that the system will work.

exercises.original: Her positivity meant she was always willing to tackle difficult tasks.

options.explanation: Can-do attitude ✓ — means energetic willingness to tackle tasks and look for solutions; it is action-oriented. In this sentence, willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue. That makes Can-do attitude the most precise choice rather than merely a broadly positive word.

Constructive attitude — means responding in a solution-focused, productive way; it is about how someone deals with problems or feedback. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue.

Positive attitude — is a broad everyday phrase for a generally favourable and encouraging way of behaving or thinking. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue.

Optimism — means expecting favourable outcomes or believing that things will improve; it is strongly future-oriented. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue.

Motivation — is the drive or reason that prompts action, not positivity itself. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue.

Enthusiasm — is strong interest and energy, not necessarily optimism or constructive thinking. It belongs to the same general positive-emotion/attitude field, but it misses the decisive clue here: willingness to take action and solve problems is the defining clue.

falseSynonyms.zh: 快樂 ≠ positivity happiness 是情緒狀態；positivity 是較廣的正面態度／傾向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Happiness is an emotion, not necessarily a mindset.

falseSynonyms.zh: 開朗 ≠ positivity cheerfulness 是愉快、開朗的外在情緒，不一定有 optimism 或 constructive thinking。
只在『有信心』sense 接近 confidence 關乎能力／成功信念，不等於所有正面態度。
希望 ≠ positivity hope 可以存在於一個具體願望中，不一定表示整體正面心態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hope can be situation-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動機 ≠ positivity motivation 是推動行動的原因或動力。
熱情 ≠ positivity enthusiasm 是興奮與投入，不一定代表樂觀或建設性態度。
接近但不完全等於 positivity positive thinking 偏刻意思考方式；positivity 可包括態度、語氣和氣氛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Positive thinking is one expression of positivity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 positive 是形容詞；positivity 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Positive is an adjective; positivity is a noun.
